docs.summary: Maps a dragged script asset (a `.cs` file) to the component `Type` it defines. Scripts are not runtime assets (the importer only triggers recompilation), so the type is resolved by matching the file name against a [`Component`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Component) type of the same name in the loaded assemblies - the same file-name-equals-class-name convention the script pipeline already relies on.
Resolve the component type a dragged asset represents, or null if it isn't a single script file that maps to a concrete [`Component`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Component).
Resolve the component type for a script file name/path (must end in `.cs`).
